name: Annapurna Sanctuary
season: February to March for touring; October to November and March to May for Tharpu Chuli
about: A ring of 6,000m to 8,000m peaks around Annapurna Base Camp. Open bowls under Annapurna I and Machapuchare make it the best place in Nepal to learn to ski tour.
guide: Ski touring in the Annapurna region

name: Thorong La
about: The high pass of the Annapurna Circuit, between Manang and Mustang. Skied in late winter from camps above Muktinath.

name: Langtang
season: October to November and March to May
about: The closest big ski terrain to Kathmandu. Glaciers and peaks above Kyanjin Gompa, with Yala Peak and Naya Kanga as the usual ski objectives.

name: Mera Peak
season: October to November and March to May
about: Nepal's highest trekking peak. Wide, gentle glaciers make it one of the most skiable 6,000m peaks in the country, with a long descent to the Mera La.

name: Island Peak
season: October to November and April to May
about: Imja Tse, in the Imja valley near Everest. The summit headwall is usually climbed on fixed ropes; the glacier below is the ski line.

name: Himlung Himal
about: A 7,000m peak in the restricted Nar Phu valley, near the Tibetan border. Big, open slopes for experienced ski mountaineers.

name: Putha Hiunchuli
about: Wide, open slopes in remote Dolpo, at the western end of the Dhaulagiri range. One of the most skiable 7,000m peaks in Nepal.

name: Kalinchowk
season: December to February, when snow falls
about: Nepal's only lift-served slope: a short beginner rope tow at Kuri, run by the Ski and Snowboarding Foundation Nepal. Snow comes and goes, so check before the drive from Kathmandu.
